readme: Playgama Bridge SDK configuration. Bridge fetches ./playgama-bridge-config.json next to index.html; top-level values apply to every platform and the `platforms` block overrides them per platform id.

This is the studio default. Every value below is a safe neutral choice, not a submission-ready one: the ad placements carry no native ids, `leaderboards`, `achievements` and `payments` are empty, and `device.supportedOrientations` claims both orientations.

A game overrides it by writing its own file over the staged copy in the build output (build/wasm-release-playgama/bin/playgama-bridge-config.json) before packaging. Author that file with the official editor at https://playgama.github.io/bridge-config-editor/ so the native placement, leaderboard and product ids match the developer console.
Delete `replace_before_submission` in the game-owned file. While it is present, package_web.mjs refuses to build a ZIP, which is what keeps this template out of a submission.
Bridge carries unknown keys through without complaint, so `readme` and `replace_before_submission` are inert at runtime.
A wrong-schema file does not fail loudly either: Bridge parses it, finds no placements or ids, and falls back to defaults. Check a changed config against the running build, not against the parse.
